name: Henry Edmund Gurney

summary.text: Henry Edmund Gurney was a partner and director of Overend, Gurney & Co., the London discount house that suspended payment on 10 May 1866. He was among the directors prosecuted for conspiracy and fraud over the firm's 1865 flotation; the case, The Queen v. Gurney and Others, was heard in the Court of Queen's Bench and a report of it was published in 1870.

openQuestions: Site claim tested: the page says the directors were 'tried at the Old Bailey over the 1865 prospectus and acquitted'. The sources found place the case in the Court of Queen's Bench (Guildhall sittings) and do not state the verdict; the acquittal is widely recorded but was not confirmed here. Owner should check the 1870 Stevens & Haynes report.
No source was found naming John Henry Gurney or Edward Watkin Edwards in connection with the trial; no files were written for them.
